llm_response.reason: The website purports to be a North Sails retailer but uses a non-brand, personal domain and generic template. There are unusually large discounts (30% sale), missing business identity details, claim to be able to shop 100% securely without substantiation, and it impersonates a well-known brand with no evidence of affiliation, fulfilling scam criteria: (1) unusually low prices, (4) information on non-existent company, (5) excessive product range unlike real e-commerce, (7) ambiguous privacy clarification, and (16) mimicking a legitimate company. These collectively indicate a fake online shop.
